title: INCOLOR Voyager product manual
notes: Current exact-model manufacturer document identifies T800 construction, an 850 g size-54 frame basis excluding paint and metal hardware, 190 N/mm bottom-bracket stiffness under an XC mountain-bike test standard, 45C knobby-tire clearance, drivetrain limits and the included gravel frame, fork, cockpit, seatpost and accessory package. Manufacturer performance claims are not independent test results.
